name: Mypage SEO Content Studio
author: MP Team

sections.description:
Are you spending hours every day brainstorming articles, hunting for the right images, and struggling to perfectly optimize your SEO tags? Let Mypage SEO Content Studio do the heavy lifting for you! Designed by SEO experts and WordPress developers, Mypage SEO Content Studio turns your website into an automated, AI-driven content machine powered by the latest models (Google Gemini 2.5 Flash, Imagen 3, and Stability AI). It doesn’t just write generic text; it creates beautifully structured, SEO-optimized articles and products, complete with meta tags and automatically generated featured images.

🚀 LITE VERSION FEATURES (FREE)

The free version gives you the power to generate unlimited high-quality posts or products (processed one by one):
* SEO-Optimized Content: The AI is meticulously trained to write long-form content (~1500 words), perfectly structuring H2/H3 headings and naturally inserting LSI keywords.
* Yoast SEO & Rank Math Integration: Automatically generates and fills in the perfect Title and Meta Description tags for maximum search engine visibility.
* WooCommerce Ready: Don’t just run a blog! Mypage SEO Content Studio can generate full WooCommerce products including Product Name, Regular/Sale Price, Categories, Brands, and Short Descriptions.
* Flexible Scheduling: Choose exactly when your content goes live (Publish immediately or Schedule for the future).
* Custom Prompts & Tones: Give the AI specific instructions (e.g., “Write in a humorous tone”, “Focus on the pros and cons”).
* Stock Photo Automation (Auto Pexels): The system automatically translates your keyword, searches Pexels for royalty-free images, downloads them, converts them to lightweight WebP format, and sets them as the Featured Image.
* Role Management: Administrators can easily configure which user roles (Authors, Editors, etc.) are allowed to use the generator.

👑 UNLEASH BULK AUTOMATION WITH PRO (ADD-ON)

Ready to build massive PBNs, auto-blogs, or fill your WooCommerce store with hundreds of products? Upgrade to Mypage SEO Content Studio to unlock enterprise-level bulk automation:

  • Bulk Content Generation: Create dozens of posts and products simultaneously with our advanced queue system.
  • Background Processing: Add 50+ keywords to the queue, click “Run in Background,” and safely close your browser! Your server will automatically process and publish the posts silently in the background. No more timeout errors or waiting around.
  • AI Image Generation (AI Draw): Let Google Imagen 3 or Stability AI draw completely unique, copyright-free illustrations based on your article’s context.
  • Smart Internal Linking Strategy: Automatically scans and inserts up to 3 highly relevant internal links into your new articles with perfectly natural anchor texts, instantly boosting your site’s Silo structure and SEO score.
  • **Revamp Feature (New): Automatically analyzes and revamps old, underperforming articles to recover lost traffic. It optimizes the content structure to strictly meet E-E-A-T standards while safely preserving your original URLs.

External services

This plugin relies on third-party services to generate high-quality text and images. By using this plugin, data (such as your generated prompts and keywords) may be sent to these services.
* Google Gemini API: Used to generate the core text content, SEO meta tags, and translations.
– Terms of Service: https://policies.google.com/terms
– Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy
* Stability AI API (PRO): Used for generating unique AI illustrations based on article context.
– Terms of Service: https://stability.ai/terms-of-use
– Privacy Policy: https://stability.ai/privacy-policy
* Pexels API (PRO): Used to search and download royalty-free stock images for featured images.
– Terms of Service: https://www.pexels.com/terms-of-service/
– Privacy Policy: https://www.pexels.com/privacy-policy/
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/mypage-seo-content-studio/ directory, or install the plugin directly through the WordPress plugins screen (Plugins > Add New).
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to Mypage SEO Content Studio > Settings in your WordPress dashboard.
  4. Get your free API Key from Google AI Studio and paste it into the Core Text AI Configuration section.
  5. You are ready to generate content! Go to Mypage SEO Content Studio > Add New.
  6. (Optional) To unlock bulk features, purchase the Pro Add-on from our website, install it alongside the Lite version, and follow the activation instructions provided.
sections.faq:
Do I have to pay for the Google Gemini API?

Google AI Studio currently offers a very generous free tier for their API, which is more than enough for the daily content generation needs of most users.

Does the plugin support multiple languages?

Yes, absolutely! Just enter your keyword in your desired language (e.g., Spanish, French, Vietnamese), and the AI will automatically write the entire article and optimize the SEO tags in that exact language.

Will the auto-image feature slow down my website?

Not at all! Our system is highly optimized. When it downloads an image from Pexels or generates one via AI, it automatically compresses and converts the image to the next-gen WebP format before saving it to your Media Library, ensuring your Google PageSpeed scores remain high.

Can my Authors or Editors use this tool?

Yes. In the System Settings, the Administrator can easily select which WordPress user roles are permitted to access the generator menu.

How do I upgrade to the PRO version?

Simply visit our website at [https://plugins.mypage.vn/], purchase the PRO Add-on, install the zip file on your WordPress site (keep the Lite version active), and activate your license to unlock all premium features.

What is the difference between the Lite version and the Pro version?

The Lite version (this version) allows you to generate content and manually fill in meta data for Yoast SEO and Rank Math on a per-post basis. The Pro version, available at plugins.mypage.vn, unlocks full automation with background processing, introduces the Revamp feature to refresh old content, automatically generates illustrative images using AI, and Smart Internal Linking Strategy.
sections.changelog:
1.0.3

  • Tweak: Updated CSS for full compatibility with WordPress 7.0.2.

1.0.2

  • Updated: Plugin URI to the new official homepage.
  • Added (Pro): Introduced the new “Revamp” feature in Mypage SEO Content Studio Pro. Automatically analyze and refresh underperforming articles to recover lost traffic while maintaining original URLs.

1.0.1

  • Tweak: Updated the automatic image naming mechanism to use keyword slugs for a cleaner structure.
  • Tweak: Restructured the plugin to completely separate background processes and AI image generation into the Pro version.
  • Fixed: Resolved a code leak issue from the previous version.

1.0.0

  • Initial Release.
  • Core integration with Google Gemini 2.5 Flash API for blazing-fast content generation.
  • Full compatibility with Yoast SEO and Rank Math.
  • Introduced Auto Pexels with WebP compression
  • Added WooCommerce product generation support.
  • PRO: Introduced Background Processing Queue for Bulk Generation.
  • PRO: Introduced AI Draw (Imagen 3 & Stability AI) with WebP compression.
  • PRO: Introduced Smart Internal Linking system.
